notes.title: Achivments and Linux Build
notes.content:
Hey Frog Fans! 🐸

We’re excited to bring you a fresh update packed with improvements and new features for our froggy adventure game. Here’s what’s new:
🐧 Linux Port

We’ve heard your requests and are thrilled to announce that our game is now available on Linux! Enjoy the game on your favorite platform.
👅 Tongue Fixes

We’ve squashed some pesky bugs related to the frog’s tongue mechanics. Catching flies should now be smoother and more responsive than ever.
🛠️ Godot Version 4.3 Upgrade

We’ve upgraded to Godot version 4.3, which includes several UI bug fixes. Your gameplay experience should now be more seamless and visually appealing.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Keep hopping and catching those flies!

Happy gaming, The Frog Team

notes.title: Bugfixes and Improvments
notes.content:
-Shorten the Time for restarting and going in the Main Menu
-Hides the mouse during Gameplay
-Cap the fps for more efficente use and less weird Bugs.
-Added a windowname
-After some feedback from player is it now easier to go from the Gamesettingsmenu in the main game
-Removed the flickering screen issue for some players.
The linux Version is still in development and should be pushed be eather the next or after that update.

notes.title: Day One Patch
notes.content:
-Fixed a game-breaking bug.
-Addressed various bugs related to the tongue functionality.
-Fixed a bug where the tongue sound played even when the player was the fly.
-Enlarged the colliders for the fly.
-The quit button in the pause menu now works as intended and no longer removes frogs from the game when they rejoin.
